subject: English
question_text: Complete the following text with right forms of the verbs given in the box. 0.5  10 =
stimulus: acquire prepare make be contribute prepare create pivot equate see The Prophet Mohammed (SM) (a) ⎯⎯ one literate non-believer with ten illiterate believers. Islamic civilization (b) ⎯⎯ on literacy and patronage of scholarship. Ibn Sina (called Avicenna in the West), one of the most famous Muslim philosophers of all times, (c) ⎯⎯ the task of education as (d) ⎯⎯ a complete citizen, physically, mentally and morally, and (e) ⎯⎯ him for a profession whereby he could earn his own livelihood and (f) ⎯⎯ to the society. In the views of Al-Farabi, another great Muslim philosopher, education (g) ⎯⎯ one of the most important social phenomena which (h) ⎯⎯ sure that the individual was (i) ⎯⎯ from an early age to (j) ⎯⎯ values, knowledge and practical skills within a particular culture.
guide_solution: (a) equated (b) pivoted (c) saw (d) creating (e) prepare (f) contribute (g) is (h) makes (i) prepared (j) acquire
